finalText:
**Migrated 12 files to `db.execute`.**

Each had 3 call sites. All 36 now pass `{ sql, params }`.

[vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9) still calls `db.query`. Its header says do not edit. Upgrades overwrite it wholesale.

All 75 package files parse under `node --check`. No tests exist to run.

Next: keep the `query` shim for `legacy-orm`.
